recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀的 CD45 對側散射（SS）圖，非形態影像；淋巴球閘門佔活細胞 79.66%、顆粒球只有 11.67%，代表明顯的淋巴球增多，其中藍色 AX 族群側散射低但 CD45 表現比正常淋巴球弱。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD45-KO (x-axis, log) versus side scatter intensity (y-axis, linear), gated on [Living Cells]
Lymphs gate containing 79.66% of events versus Grans gate with 11.67%, indicating marked lymphocytosis
Dominant blue population in gate AX with low side scatter and CD45 intensity (about 10^0) lower than the green/magenta lymphocytes
Green/magenta low side scatter population with bright CD45 (about 10^1.5) representing residual normal lymphocytes
Grey high side scatter granulocytes and intermediate side scatter monocytes with moderate CD45
describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side scatter plot of viable cells shows a predominance of low side scatter events, with the lymphocyte gate comprising 79.66% of events and granulocytes only 11.67%. The dominant low side scatter population (blue, gate AX) displays CD45 intensity lower than the residual normal lymphocytes (green/magenta), which is an unexpected pattern for mature T cells and should be interpreted with caution because fluorochrome brightness, compensation and gating details are not shown. Monocytes and granulocytes are present in their expected regions. The findings document an expanded lymphoid population consistent with the leukemic phase of T-prolymphocytic leukemia, to be characterized by lineage markers on the gated population.
